top_signals.title: Iran Foreign Ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
